description: This PHP source file defines the 'Authorize' class within the Opencart platform, responsible for handling email notifications related to account authorization and reset events. It includes methods to generate and send authorization and reset emails based on session data, customer info, and configuration settings.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Handles email notifications for account authorization and reset processes within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sends an authorization email to the customer if the session code exists, using configured email templates.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Sends a reset authorization email to the customer based on provided user ID and code, constructing a reset link.
